///- --package . --timeout 2400000
open xml_codec

prototype to_text t : t -> string

inl text_node forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : t) : xml.xml_node =
    xml.element name [] (xml.text_children (to_text v))

inl optional_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : option t) : list xml.xml_node =
    xml.option_list (optionm.map (text_node name) v)

inl repeated_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (vs : list t) : list xml.xml_node =
    listm.map (text_node name) vs

nominal lexical t = { value : t; text : string }

instance to_text lexical t = fun x => x.text

inl lexical_of forall t. (text : string) (value : option t) : option (lexical t) =
    optionm.map (fun v => lexical { value = v; text = text }) value

inl whole_of (text : string) : option i64 =
    if sm'.index_of "." text >= 0i32 then None
    else optionm.map (fun (d : decimal.decimal) => d.units) (decimal.parse text)

inl whole_at_least (least : i64) (text : string) : option i64 =
    match whole_of text with
    | Some n => if n >= least then Some n else None
    | None => None

inl boolean_of (text : string) : option bool =
    match xml.collapsed_space text with
    | "true" => Some true
    | "1" => Some true
    | "false" => Some false
    | "0" => Some false
    | _ => None

type xsd_decimal = lexical decimal.decimal

inl xsd_decimal_of_string (s : string) : option xsd_decimal = lexical_of s (decimal.parse s)

inl xsd_decimal_example (_ : i32) : xsd_decimal = lexical { value = decimal.of_int 1i64; text = "1" }

inl xsd_decimal_example_text (_ : i32) : string = "1"

type xsd_integer = lexical i64

inl xsd_integer_of_string (s : string) : option xsd_integer = lexical_of s (whole_of s)

inl xsd_integer_example (_ : i32) : xsd_integer = lexical { value = 1i64; text = "1" }

inl xsd_integer_example_text (_ : i32) : string = "1"

type xsd_boolean = lexical bool

inl xsd_boolean_of_string (s : string) : option xsd_boolean = lexical_of s (boolean_of s)

inl xsd_boolean_example (_ : i32) : xsd_boolean = lexical { value = true; text = "true" }

inl xsd_boolean_example_text (_ : i32) : string = "true"

type x_receiving_note_purpose_type = string

inl x_receiving_note_purpose_type_is_valid (s : string) : bool = true

inl x_receiving_note_purpose_type_example (_ : i32) : string = "1"

inl x_receiving_note_purpose_type_example_text (k : i32) : string = x_receiving_note_purpose_type_example k

type x_reverse_delivery_note_purpose_type = string

inl x_reverse_delivery_note_purpose_type_is_valid (s : string) : bool = true

inl x_reverse_delivery_note_purpose_type_example (_ : i32) : string = "1"

inl x_reverse_delivery_note_purpose_type_example_text (k : i32) : string =
    x_reverse_delivery_note_purpose_type_example k

inl x_currency_type_example (k : i32) : x_currency_type =
    inl index = ((k % 8i32) + 8i32) % 8i32
    if index = 0i32 then CurrencyType_AED
    elif index = 1i32 then CurrencyType_AFN
    elif index = 2i32 then CurrencyType_ALL
    elif index = 3i32 then CurrencyType_AMD
    elif index = 4i32 then CurrencyType_ANG
    elif index = 5i32 then CurrencyType_AOA
    elif index = 6i32 then CurrencyType_ARS
    else CurrencyType_AUD

inl x_currency_type_example_text (k : i32) : string = x_currency_type_to_string (x_currency_type_example k)

instance to_text x_invoice_type = fun x => x_invoice_type_to_string x

inl x_invoice_type_example (k : i32) : x_invoice_type =
    inl index = ((k % 8i32) + 8i32) % 8i32
    if index = 0i32 then InvoiceType_1_1
    elif index = 1i32 then InvoiceType_1_2
    elif index = 2i32 then InvoiceType_1_3
    elif index = 3i32 then InvoiceType_1_4
    elif index = 4i32 then InvoiceType_1_5
    elif index = 5i32 then InvoiceType_1_6
    elif index = 6i32 then InvoiceType_2_1
    else InvoiceType_2_2

inl x_invoice_type_example_text (k : i32) : string = x_invoice_type_to_string (x_invoice_type_example k)
